Phase 62 plan: docs/phases/framework-provenance-from-earlier-releases.md @ 76f8f6c (branch phase/framework-provenance-from-earlier-releases). Arbiter asked for this cycle after seeing the numbers below.

Problem: Phase 61 (released 3.14.0) only removes what it can prove. tagteam upgrade --preview over the 41 registered projects: 184 retire, 296 templates kept as 'differs from the package', 36 docs/workflows.md kept, 0 refused. 37 of 41 projects would be left with a half-emptied templates/. I checked every kept file against every framework file at every git tag: all 296 templates are byte-exact renderings of the single earlier source (v0.3.0-v3.11.0, with {{lead}}/{{reviewer}}) using the project's configured names (setup baked names in until 3.12.0; the current package has no placeholders, so _render_variants has nothing to render); the 36 workflows.md are verbatim v3.10.0 (35) / v3.11.0 (1). Zero owner edits.

Plan: ship the 13 earlier sources (~31 KB, closed set - retired paths never change again, workflows.md >= 3.13.0 is manifest-vouched) as tagteam/data/history/<last-tag>/<source_rel>; _classify() gains one evidence step (verbatim, or _render_variants over the historical bytes) -> framework + reconstructible. No new action code: retired paths retire, workflows.md refreshes. Also folds in your Phase 61 non-blocking note (_prune_retired_dirs silent on OSError).

Please press on: (1) is 'source + the project's own configured names' reconstructible in the sense you required in Phase 61, given tagteam.yaml is the owner's file and can change after classification; (2) sources vs a sha table (Scope 4) - I chose one mechanism; (3) auto-refreshing 36 pre-manifest workflows.md (open question to the arbiter; precedent is manifest/known-contract refresh); (4) criterion 1 pinning the table to git history with a skip on tagless clones - is a skip acceptable there, or should CI fetch tags; (5) swapped-names matching for a delete, not just a refresh.

Verified: tagteam roadmap check ok (63 phases). The provenance analysis was a read-only script over the registry, not committed. No code changed; suite not run (plan cycle).

Approved plan at 76f8f6c. Independently compared framework source hashes across local release tags through v3.12.0 (including the older ai_handoff/data prefix): the inventory is exactly the 13 historical sources listed. Shipping exact sources is appropriate for both verbatim and name-rendered evidence. Exact configured/swapped-name renderings are consistent with the Phase 61 policy; the file preimage recheck must remain unchanged. Historical workflows refresh is consistent with existing framework refresh behavior. No additional approval or flag is needed for that scoped behavior.

Implementation notes:
- The existing _old_project phase_plan.md fixture is NOT an exact historical rendering: it is a short synthetic '# Phase / Roles' document and uses capitalized names while its config uses lowercase. Preserve that document as custom. Add a full historical source rendered with matching configured names for the installed-wheel retirement assertion; do not simply flip the existing fixture's expected action.
- CI already has fetch-depth: 0 in both tests jobs and publish, so the tag-based provenance test can run there. A skip on genuinely tagless local/source checkouts is acceptable. The coverage comparison must account for the older ai_handoff/data path.
- Preserve conservative manifest-first behavior as scoped: a manifest match currently returns before historical evidence, so some manifest-vouched files may still require git recovery even when a historical source exists. Avoid claiming every earlier copy is necessarily retired. Likewise keep the docs precise about the bounded historical set and renamed-name exclusions.
- Source plus matched names establishes reconstructibility at classification time, not a permanent archive after the owner changes tagteam.yaml; no new backup mechanism is required for these framework renderings. Do not weaken exact-byte matching or infer names from arbitrary file text.

Read-only source/tag inspection only; no test suite run. Prune-error reporting and preview-only registry verification are appropriately scoped.
